title: Report the questions
instructions: Write the questions in **reported speech**. The beginning is already there.

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "Where is the nearest supermarket?"
items.answer: Mila asked Sofia where the nearest supermarket was.
items.hint: Question word **where** stays. Word order: *the nearest supermarket was*.

items.direct: Diego to Mila: "Do you like American football?"
items.answer: Diego asked Mila [if|whether] she liked American football.

items.direct: Tyler: "What time does the bus leave?"
items.answer: Tyler wanted to know what time the bus left.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Mila: "Are you homesick?"
items.answer: Mrs Moreno asked Mila [if|whether] she was homesick.

items.direct: Aisha to Mila: "Why did you choose Lakeview High?"
items.answer: Aisha asked Mila why she had chosen Lakeview High.

items.direct: Sofia to Diego: "Have you seen my phone?"
items.answer: Sofia asked Diego [if|whether] he had seen her phone.
items.hint: have seen → had seen, my → her

items.direct: Mr Okafor to Mila: "Which subjects are you taking?"
items.answer: Mr Okafor asked Mila which subjects she was taking.

items.direct: Mila to Tyler: "Will you come to the party?"
items.answer: Mila asked Tyler [if|whether] he would come to the party.

items.direct: Diego to Mila: "How long are you going to stay in the USA?"
items.answer: Diego wanted to know how long [Mila|she] was going to stay in the USA.
items.hint: are you going to → **she was going to**

items.direct: Coach Brooks to the team: "Can you all come on Saturday?"
items.answer: Coach Brooks asked the team [if|whether] [they could all|they all could|they could] come on Saturday.
items.hint: Yes/no question. can → could, you → they
